summary: A freestanding 4.9 m wide, 4 m tall bouldering wall: a 0.45 m vertical kicker, a 20-degree overhang and a 10-… options wall; sockets socket_start_red, socket_start_blue, socket_start_yellow, socket_start_green, socket_start_purple, socket_top.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.climbing_hold_wall or place "prefab": "climbing_hold_wall" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
